name: opencode-v2-support-window
body:
Law (prose; assessed by review): each apg release line supports exactly one opencode major, and that pairing IS the support window — the apg 0.21.x line supports opencode v1, the apg 0.22.x line supports opencode v2, and no apg release line supports both opencode majors. The apg opencode integration in the 0.22.x line targets opencode 2.x: the suite plugin uses the `@opencode/plugin` API, and the shipped agent templates and repo `opencode.json` adopt the 2.x native shape. A V1-only opencode runtime sits outside the 0.22.x line's support window: the plugin implementation is a single 2.x implementation, and a dual V1/V2 default export (the documented `Plugin.define(...)` + `server()` spread) is not part of the product.

opencode 2.x reads legacy V1 configuration, so a repo's pre-existing V1 config and legacy agent frontmatter load under opencode 2.x; the shipped product source states the 2.x native shape.

The plugin package dependency (`@opencode/plugin`) and the install locations are the interface to the target runtime: the whole suite installs under the global opencode config directory `~/.config/opencode/` — the tool plugins in `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` (the documented global discovery layout, which loads direct `.ts`/`.js` files and immediate plugin package directories) and the seven distributed agents at `~/.config/opencode/agents/<name>.md`. Both are documented V2 locations.
